mapper.select: SELECT t_goods.id gid, t_goods.goodsName, t_goods.caption, t_goods.brandId, t_goods.price, t_goods.productType1Id, t_goods.productType2Id, t_goods.productType3Id, t_goods.isMarketable, t_goods.introduction, t_goods_image.id imageId, t_goods_image.imageUrl, t_goods_image.imageTitle, t_specification.id specId, t_specification.productTypeId, t_specification.specName, t_specification_option.id optionId, t_specification_option.optionName FROM t_goods LEFT JOIN t_goods_image ON t_goods.id = t_goods_image.goodsId LEFT JOIN t_goods_specification_option ON t_goods_specification_option.gid = t_goods.id LEFT JOIN t_specification_option ON t_specification_option.id = t_goods_specification_option.optionId LEFT JOIN t_specification ON t_specification.id = t_specification_option.specId WHERE t_goods.id = #{id}
